items.title: 3 U.S. Dividend Stocks Offering Defensive Income as Fed Rate Pressure Persists
items.summary: With traders bracing for another possible 0.25% Fed hike in October, solid labor data and firm inflation keep pressure on anything seen as risky. Defensive dividend stocks suddenly feel less boring and more like a potential anchor for a jumpier market, especially for investors who care about steady income when policy stays tight. items.title: The Cheapest Stocks in the S&P 500: Are They a Bargain or a Trap?
items.summary: Inflation is stubbornly high, but not in home broadband service.  There, telecom operators are making fiberoptic inroads in a business long dominated by cable television companies.  The result has been discounting:  UBS  reports that prices for various broadband service tiers are down 7% to 14% for fiber over the past year, and 17% to 27% for cable.
